tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification stays enabled in every build, development builds included, so it is not disabled in dev builds.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. It says TLS certificate verification stays enabled in every build, development builds included.

That statement rests on one record only, which is weak evidence. Muninn's `why` check came back "insufficient", because nothing on record is above trust 1, meaning it was only seen in a session transcript. The record is #21, "verification on all builds", which was said after #20, "certificate verification disabled in dev builds". Muninn has not marked #21 as replacing #20, so I treated the later statement as current. If #20 was actually the intended policy, tell me and I'll change the file. As requested, the doc doesn't mention the earlier "disabled in dev" position.

The first attempt to write the file through Bash failed with a parser error, so I used the Write tool instead.
